headline: Space Invaders - the game that started it all
title: Space Invaders Facts | First Endless Arcade Shooter | Classic Games
video_script: Space Invaders came out in nineteen seventy eight, made by Taito for arcades. It was the first video game with endless gameplay, and the very first fixed shooter, so almost every space shooter after it copied its idea. You move a laser cannon left and right and blast waves of aliens before they reach the ground. Did you ever play it? Comment below!
description: Space Invaders (1978, Taito): the first video game with endless gameplay and the first fixed shooter.
